Michaela: Heads-up — Nimbulus (new GPU partner) asked for our marketplace deployment stencil. They want a Terraform module, ARM64 + CUDA variants, packaging guidance, and a short ops playbook by EOW. Anyone take ownership?
Ashwin: I can own the Terraform module. Need clarity on supported hw (A100 / H100 / Ampere). Do we have a compatibility matrix to share?
Samir: We should reuse ref-llm-deploy patterns but add a hw selector and simplified defaults. @Ashwin maybe a var like `gpu_type = "h100"` and a minimal example app.
Ashwin: ```terraform
module "nimbulus_ref" {
  source   = "github.com/redwood-inference/partner-stencils/nimbulus"
  gpu_type = var.gpu_type # h100 | a100 | ampere
  region   = var.region
}
```
Kevin: For marketplace packaging we'll need partner-signed manifest + SBOM and a short TOC about supported SKUs. @Michaela can you confirm Nimbulus can provide SBOM and test images?
Michaela: Yes, they said SBOM + OCI test images available. They also want us to surface a "Redwood Verified" perf blurb — use non-prod benchmark numbers and link to our perf doc in the README.
Nora: Ops note — add a CI smoke job: `ci/test-marketplace-deploy.sh --partner nimbulus --gpu h100`. I'll add a GitHub Actions workflow stub and a teardown step.
cloud-partner-bot: Created ticket P-3421: "Nimbulus marketplace seed module + CI test" assigned to @Ashwin
Ashwin: I'll draft the module and open a PR by Wed. Can someone add a tiny sample app (fastchat-ish) and a prompt set for basic perf/regression tests?
Samir: On it — will add `examples/fastchat-minimal` and a prompt set + eval harness.
Michaela: :thumbsup: Thanks team — let's sync tomorrow 10:00am PT to review the PR and CI job.
